title: Lakatan Banana (saging na lakatan): Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Lakatan Banana: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Lakatan banana is a banana variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Lakatan is a registered banana variety, also sold or known as saging na lakatan or Lacatan. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1991. Institute of Plant Breeding bred it.

heroImage.alt: Banana plants with bagged bunches along a farm road in Panabo City, the kind of farm where Lakatan banana is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for saging na lakatan or Lacatan, this is the same banana. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [banana variety finder](/crop-varieties/banana), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [banana farming in the Philippines](/crops/banana-farming-philippines).
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit banana fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Banana aphid](/pests/banana-aphid), [Banana bunchy top](/diseases/banana-bunchy-top), [Banana weevil](/pests/banana-weevil), [black sigatoka](/diseases/black-sigatoka). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of Lakatan weighs about 70 to 100 grams, and its shape is narrowly ellipsoid. The flesh is yellow orange and firm.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Fingers about 14 cm, 70 to 100 g, golden yellow skin, yellow orange firm sweet flesh, more beta carotene than most bananas.
Registered in 1991 with the Philippine Seed Board.
Susceptible to banana bunchy top virus.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the most popular dessert banana in the Philippines, priced above Latundan and Cavendish. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Lakatan banana

Lakatan and latundan sell fresh, saba goes to cooking and banana cue, and Cavendish goes to export. Fusarium wilt and bunchy top end many farms, so plant clean tissue cultured plantlets, and a tolerant selection where wilt is known. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for banana](/land-preparation/banana-land-preparation).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is saging na lakatan the same as Lakatan?
items.a: Yes. saging na lakatan is another name for Lakatan. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Lakatan?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
